instructions.question: Does this Czech Facebook post express a clear opinion about the page's brand, product or service: positive (praise, love, delight with it), negative (complaint, criticism, mockery of it), or neutral (no clear evaluation of the brand)?
instructions.rule: Judge only the opinion about the brand, its products, ads, animals or service, not the general mood or emoticons. Neutral is the default and covers several kinds of post: thanks for an answer or fix, hopes and wishes, requests and suggestions, contest entries, saying you bought or own something, user banter, own-life stories, and praise or sadness about non-brand things. Mild regret about circumstances also stays neutral. Negative needs a clear complaint, criticism or sarcasm aimed at the brand. Positive needs clear praise, delight or loyalty towards the brand or its products.

neutral.what: Questions, information, requests, suggestions, plain fault reports, thanks, hopes, contest chatter, user banter, jokes, and feelings not aimed at the brand.
examples: Už mám objednáno =) (I've already ordered)
Díky za odpověď. Tak to to na rozsvícení bohužel nestíháme... :( (Thanks for the reply. Unfortunately we won't make it to the lighting...)
Chci levnější volání, 3G pokrytí, Internet bez cenzury a bez FUP. (I want cheaper calls, 3G coverage, internet without censorship and without FUP.)
neutral.cues: díky za odpověď (thanks for the reply), doufám (I hope), snad (hopefully), prosím (please), mě by se hodily (I could use), jak (how), :) or :( without an evaluation of the brand
neutral.not_for: Clear frustration with the brand ('už mě to přestává bavit' (I'm getting fed up)) is negative; clear love of its products is positive.

positive.what: Explicit praise or enthusiasm about the brand's products, ads, animals, staff or service, and loyalty statements.
examples: já mám o2 13 let a neměnila bych (I've had O2 for 13 years and wouldn't switch)
Jaký je ňuňatýý! :)) (How cute it is!)
Kam se hrabou reklamy na T Mobile :D (T-Mobile's ads can't compare)
positive.cues: skvělé (great), úžasné (amazing), miluju (I love), nejlepší (best), doporučuju (I recommend), chutná (tastes good)
positive.not_for: Thanks for an answer ('Díky za odpověď'), hopes ('snad se dočkáme :)'), 'Už mám objednáno =)' (Already ordered), wanting a prize, and praise of non-brand things are neutral.

negative.what: Clear complaints or criticism of the brand: price, service, quality, removed products, threats to leave, sarcasm or mockery of its offers.
examples: Jdu si do trafiky pro simku konkurence, už mě to přestává bavit. (I'm going to get a competitor's SIM, I'm getting fed up.)
FUP 2 GB za 333,-Kč :-))))) už dlouho mě tak nikdo nepobavil (FUP 2 GB for 333 CZK, nobody has amused me this much in ages)
bez prasátka to už neni ono :D (without the piggy it's not the same)
negative.cues: předražený (overpriced), nefunguje (doesn't work), odejdu (I'll leave), konkurence (competitor), zklamal (disappointed), fuj (yuck), už nikdy (never again)
negative.not_for: Suggestions, wishes for better offers, neutral fault questions, sad smileys about one's own situation, and arguing with other users are neutral.
